This browser won't let Doodle Days save. Entries will be lost when you close it.
How do I add a sticker?
Open a day and tap a sticker in the row under the page, or tap “Stickers” for the full tray. Then tap the page where you want it.
Tick an activity on a day to count it. Your streak is how many days in a row you've ticked it. Each week, one missed day is forgiven, so a single busy day won't break it.
On this device, never on our servers. Once Google sign-in arrives, you can choose to sync a copy through your own Google Drive. Save a backup file now and then so nothing gets lost.
How do I move to a new phone?
In Settings, tap “Save backup file” and keep it somewhere safe, like iCloud Drive or Google Drive. On the new phone, install Doodle Days and tap “Restore from backup”.
Why don't reminders show when the app is closed?
The app can only show reminders while it's open. Open a plan and tap “Add to phone calendar” to get reminders from your phone's calendar instead.
Can I draw with a stylus?
Yes. Lines get thicker when you press harder, and a “Stylus only” button appears so your palm doesn't draw.
Go to Settings, then “Recently deleted”. Plans, photos, activities and doodles stay there for 30 days.

How safe is the PIN lock?
The PIN stops others from opening the app on your device. It doesn't encrypt your entries, so keep your device's own screen lock on too.
How do I change the language?

Keep your entries safe on iPhone.

Safari can erase website data if you don't visit for 7 days. Add Doodle Days to your Home Screen: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Already have entries here? Save a backup first, then restore it in the Home Screen app.
Why did my entries disappear on iPhone?

When Doodle Days is used in Safari, iPhone can erase its data if you don’t open it for 7 days. Safari and the Home Screen app also keep separate copies. Add Doodle Days to your Home Screen and save a backup file now and then, and your entries stay safe.
